entities.summary: Michael Machion Harris II is an American professional baseball center fielder for the Atlanta Braves of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was selected by the Braves in the third round of the 2019 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut with them in 2022, and won the National League Rookie of the Year Award.
